pages.text: A new body, Collar Cam fitted, in 60 s, for 16 rotten flesh, 8 bone blocks, 4 redstone blocks, 8 slime balls, 2,000 mB of saline and 200 kFE stored first.

$(l)Load it before you need it:$() when you do, you are a jar and your things are on your corpse. Saline goes in by bucket or bottle. From a pile alone, 200 kFE take over 8 min.$(br2)Then, as the jar, press Print. Use the new body, or Swap, to step in.
